capabilities.name: Governed Benefit Knowledge and Factual Comparison
capabilities.responsibility: Represent governed benefit concepts and product implementations, discover active approved published implementations, evaluate comparison eligibility, normalize mechanics onto a common factual basis, produce deterministic structured comparisons, orchestrate the factual comparison pipeline, and project evidence-preserving education-first explanations without ranking or recommendation.
capabilities.authority_role: Benefit knowledge, factual comparison and explanation authority only; it may describe governed mechanics and factual differences but cannot aggregate them into a product score, rank alternatives, select a winner, infer suitability, decide entitlement, assess a claim, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Only active, approved and published governed implementations are eligible for discovery and comparison orchestration.
Representation differences may be normalized only through the governed mechanic model; blocked or unresolved dimensions remain explicit.
Factual comparison must preserve source limitations and may not convert missing or one-sided evidence into superiority or inferiority.
Comparison and explanation outputs remain non-ranking, non-suitability and non-recommendation artifacts.
capabilities.notes: Census registration of the existing MO-025 governed benefit discovery/comparison pipeline. It intentionally excludes intrinsic assessment, trade-off projection, publication admission and future ranking authority.

capabilities.name: Governed Benefits Pre-Ranking Handoff Boundary
capabilities.responsibility: Validate and freeze the sole admissible Benefits comparison payload that may cross toward any future ranking or recommendation consumer, rejecting blocked projections, arbitrary mappings, legacy generated outputs and recommendation-shaped objects.
capabilities.authority_role: Negative admission authority at the Benefits advice boundary only; it can reject or admit a governed comparison projection for downstream consumption but cannot rank, score, personalize, determine suitability, select a winner, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Only the exact governed comparison explanation projection type is admissible.
Blocked comparison projections cannot cross the boundary.
Historical generated outputs, dictionaries, legacy recommendation objects and arbitrary payloads are not admissible substitutes.
Any future ranking or recommendation capability must attach through this boundary rather than bypass it.
capabilities.notes: This is a fail-closed chokepoint, not recommendation authority. Current code contains no Benefits ranking or winner computation.

capabilities.name: Governed Intrinsic Benefit Assessment
capabilities.responsibility: Apply approved published qualitative assessment policies to governed product-benefit implementations, build per-product assessment profiles, and project condition-specific assessment results while preserving evidence, limitations and non-scorable outcomes.
capabilities.authority_role: Intrinsic per-benefit qualitative assessment authority only; it may classify a governed benefit dimension under an approved policy but cannot aggregate dimensions into an overall product rating, rank products, infer customer suitability, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Assessment requires governed implementations and approved published assessment policies.
Missing required mechanics or unmatched governed rules produce NOT_SCORABLE rather than a forced qualitative band.
Assessment provenance preserves source mechanics, evidence references, policy identity/version and limitations.
Per-benefit assessments may not be aggregated into a net product score, winner, suitability conclusion or recommendation.
capabilities.notes: Education-first intrinsic assessment over governed mechanics. This boundary deliberately excludes cross-product trade-off projection.

capabilities.name: Governed Non-Verdict Benefit Trade-Off Projection
capabilities.responsibility: Compare already-governed product assessment profiles one dimension at a time and project stronger, weaker, shared, unresolved, one-sided or non-comparable trade-offs with preserved protection-floor warnings and limitations.
capabilities.authority_role: Per-dimension trade-off authority only; it cannot weight or aggregate dimensions, compute a net lean, rank products, declare a winner, infer suitability, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Direct qualitative comparison requires matching governed assessment policy identity and version on both sides.
Unresolved or one-sided dimensions cannot be converted into stronger/weaker conclusions.
Protection-floor warnings and source limitations remain visible rather than being cancelled by strengths elsewhere.
The explanation decision boundary must explicitly preserve that there is no overall winner or recommendation.
capabilities.notes: Dimension-level stronger/weaker language is intentionally local and must never be collapsed into an aggregate product verdict.

capabilities.name: Governed Benefit Mechanic Semantics
capabilities.responsibility: Represent and deterministically compose governed semantics for co-payment, waiting-period, personal-underwriting, restoration and room-rent mechanics so downstream assessment and comparison consume typed domain behavior rather than ad-hoc text interpretation.
capabilities.authority_role: Typed benefit-mechanic semantic authority only; it may represent and compose already-governed mechanics but cannot establish product identity, admit arbitrary product facts, rank alternatives, determine suitability, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Mechanic composition is deterministic and must preserve conditional, cumulative, non-application and option-domain distinctions rather than flattening them.
Unknown, inapplicable or insufficient mechanic states remain explicit and cannot be guessed from prose.
Room-rent and waiting-period assessment inputs retain their governed evidence/limitation boundaries.
Typed mechanic semantics are inputs to assessment/comparison and are not product-level verdicts.
capabilities.notes: This family is kept separate from generic benefit vocabulary because these modules encode safety-relevant mechanic composition and assessment semantics.

capabilities.name: Governed Benefit Fact Publication Bridge
capabilities.responsibility: Admit explicitly reviewed and published real-product benefit facts into typed assessment contracts, preserving product/UIN identity, evidence and document lineage, effective dates, review status, publication status and source limitations.
capabilities.authority_role: Benefit-fact admission/projection authority only; it can project a reviewed published fact into the corresponding assessment contract but cannot upgrade unreviewed or unpublished facts, repair lineage, infer missing facts, rank products, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Only approved and published fact records are governed for downstream use.
Historical extractor outputs and arbitrary mappings are not admissible substitutes for the publication contract.
Product identity, UIN, evidence reference, source document identity/hash, effective dates and limitations remain bound to the projected fact.
Publication admission of one benefit fact does not authorize an overall product judgment or recommendation.
capabilities.notes: Narrow real-product fact bridge into the active Benefits assessment model; distinct from the global authoritative-publication gate.
